body:
Adds `research/deadband-twin`: a linear twin fitted to a dead-zone actuator recovers exactly `b·P(|u|>δ)` (Bussgang), an excitation property. The twin-designed P loop stalls at the zone edge `δ/K`, alternates inside it, or diverges only outside a basin `bδ/(m−2)`. Inverse-deadband compensation is asymmetric (floor `|Δ|/K` vs chatter `bΔ/(2−m)`).

- 8 unit tests pass; experiments seeded, results in `experiments/results.txt`
- README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry added; `python site/build.py` prints ok
- Stylised, simulated "real" system; limitations listed in the README and white paper
